wording_caveats: Say: 'At equal LPIPS (best Spirula cap vs our smallest matching cap), the pre-registered verdict is PARITY: on 5 of 6 scenes our run was 3.2-4.6x faster, but Spirula's best quality was at its largest tested budget (8M), so its ladder may be truncated and those scenes count as ties; on playroom our matching cap did not hold on TEST views (0/3).'
Never say 'faster than Spirula at equal quality' or 'best-tuned Spirula' or 'at any budget' from this run.
Equal-cap sentence allowed: 'At equal 500k and 1M splat caps, ours trains 1.5-2.3x faster (ratios 0.43-0.66) on 6/6 scenes with +0.6 to +1.4 dB TEST PSNR (3 runs, seed gate passes).'
Our matching cap was our own top rung (4M) on counter, and DEV margins were thin (<=0.0022 LPIPS) on counter/garden/drjohnson/playroom.
RTX PRO 6000, drivers 610.43.02/610.57.04, mixed host CPUs; Spirula v2026.10.6 --quality untuned (cap-only ladder; 30k steps for all caps); Spirula has no seed flag (runs are repeats).

Scorer binary splat-perf historical-build-029 (ae3bcdd4...), metric code identical to e1358e26; same binary scores both arms. Speed from train_s wall spans; arm order alternated by run (no cotenant field).
